blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A British national allegedly assaulted an American man inside an apartment in Panglao, Bohol, on Sunday night, Oct. 4, following an argument reportedly triggered by the suspect’s discovery that his former girlfriend had been communicating with the victim. The Panglao Police Station received a call from a concerned citizen at around 8 p.m. reporting a mauling incident in an apartment in Barangay Danao. Police officers responding to the report found numerous blood stains on the floor upon arrival.
